preconditions.description: The number of wood planks in the fence is between 1 and 100,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= hi <= 10**9 for hi in h)
preconditions.description: Each height of the fence planks is between 1 and 1,000,000,000 inclusive.
The number of queries is between 1 and 100,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= li <= ri <= n for li, ri in queries)
preconditions.description: Each query's boundaries are valid indices within the range of the fence planks.

postconditions.description: The number of results matches the number of queries.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(count, int) and count >= 0 for count in result)
postconditions.description: Each result is a non-negative integer representing the count of matching pieces.

postconditions.expression: all(count == sum(1 for l2 in range(1, n - (ri - li) + 2) if l2 != li and all(h[l1 + i - 1] + h[l2 + i - 1] == h[l1] + h[l2] for i in range(1, ri - li + 2))) for (li, ri), count in zip(queries, result))
postconditions.description: Each result correctly counts the number of distinct matching pieces for the given query.
